How do I earn cafe points?

You earn points in these ways:

  • +10 for signing up (one time only).
  • +10 for completing your profile (one time only). A complete profile has a bio, introduction, photo, job title, company, at least one work history entry, and at least one education entry.
  • +2 when you publish a post (first publish only, not edits).
  • +1 each time your post or comment is upvoted.
  • −1 each time your comment is downvoted. Posts can't be downvoted.
  • +2 when someone saves your post, and −2 if they unsave it.
  • +5 when someone reposts your article, and −5 if they undo the repost.

You can't earn or lose points by interacting with your own content.

What do points unlock?

  • 100 points: repost someone else's article.
  • 250 points: flag a post.
  • 500 points: downvote a comment. Posts can't be downvoted.

How do I write and publish a post?

  1. Click New Post.
  2. Write your title and story.
  3. Click Publish.
  4. In the Story Preview dialog, check the cover image, excerpt, and tags.
  5. Click Publish again.

To edit a published post later, make your changes and click Update.

How do @mentions work?

Type @ followed by a username, then choose the person from the dropdown. They're notified when the post is published. Editing the post later won't notify them again.

What's the difference between Save and Repost?

Save is a private bookmark that only you can see. Repost shares the article with your followers and shows it on your profile. The author gets +2 points for a save and +5 for a repost, and loses them if it's undone.

How is the Explore page ranked?

Users are ranked by total cafe points, highest first. Explore is also the search page, so it works as a leaderboard.

Can I edit a post after publishing?

Yes. Your changes update the post as normal. Editing doesn't notify mentioned people again and doesn't award points again.
